run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate slab placements and write vasp input files for a given bulk surface and adsorbate
run_precompute_slabs: run precompute_slabs to generate and save slab surfaces for a list of bulk indices using multiprocessing
run_parse_args: run parse_args to validate command line arguments for bulk adsorbate and surface index specifications and placement options
run_write_surface: run write_surface to write vasp input files and metadata pickle for a specified slab to the output directory
run_run_placements: run run_placements to execute a StructureGenerator job for a single adsorbate bulk surface index tuple with error handling
